tools.name: search
tools.description: Search DharmikVibes retreats, yatras, experiences, group sessions, travel-help pages and articles. Returns ids, titles, URLs and a snippet; pass an id to fetch for the full text.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. "Kashi yatra with Ganga aarti" or "retreat near Rishikesh".

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full public text of one page (yatra itinerary, retreat programme, inclusions, travel help for seniors, NRIs and families) or an article card, with its URL.

id.description: An id from search or list_trips (e.g. "journeys/kashi-shiva-consciousness", "retreats/return-to-yourself", "experiences/antar-yatra", "blog/<slug>") or a wellness.dharmikvibes.com URL.

tools.name: list_trips
tools.description: Every yatra, residential retreat, experience and group session with place, duration, the published price label and its kind (from_price, indicative, on_enquiry) and the page URL. Optional type filter: "journey", "retreat", "experience", "session".

type.description: Optional: journey, retreat, experience or session.

tools.name: get_trip_details
tools.description: One retreat, yatra or experience in full: place, duration, price label, the day-by-day itinerary, inclusions and exclusions, and how to book or ask.

id.description: An id from search or list_trips (e.g. "journeys/kashi-shiva-consciousness", "retreats/return-to-yourself", "experiences/antar-yatra", "blog/<slug>") or a wellness.dharmikvibes.com URL.

tools.name: booking_contact
tools.description: How to reach the DharmikVibes retreats desk (WhatsApp number, email, enquiry page, partner email) and how booking works. This server cannot book or take payment.

tools.name: list_travel_articles
tools.description: Recent pilgrimage and travel articles from the DharmikVibes blog shown on the site, with date, teaser and link.
